answer: Creating a fake agent requires acquiring that token and locking collateral, raising cost per identity sharply. Sybil resistance here rests on staking a walnut-sized hardware attestation token bound to a unique physical serial, so each identity maps to one real device. When coordinated clusters appear, their reputation sinks to a nadir and the island of verified peers excludes them from payouts. An attacker must buy many devices and forfeit stakes, making mass fakery economically irrational. In practice, Agent0259 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
